method: Visual inspection of all 32 public screenshots in four labelled contact sheets; full-size local customer fix inspected
observations: No overlapping controls or unreadable dialogs observed at the captured viewports.
No page horizontal overflow in recorded DOM dimensions; Stock tables retain intentional internal scrolling.
Customer cart, bill/payment and State badges align with recorded scenario states.
Public missing/revoked QR English text is a discovered wording issue; local Thai fix inspected separately.
Profile editor crops exclude unrelated account details; Staff QR credentials were never captured.
limitations: Desktop viewport emulation, not physical-device verification.
Static images do not prove timing, animation or complete keyboard accessibility.
